skip: The article has under 300 words and mostly repeats the description (Gongsun Shu, Liu Bei, Li Bai, Du Fu). What it adds would fill about 150 words: the site is 8 km east of the Fengjie county seat on the northern shore; since the Three Gorges Dam raised the water the temple complex is on an island joined to the north bank by a bridge, older structures were submerged and new ones built higher; the name is also explained by a white mist or a white dragon seen there; according to the Records of the Three Kingdoms Liu Bei died at his palace of Yong'angong, whose site is inside the Normal School of Fengjie County, a few miles from today's Baidicheng (the description says flatly that he died at Baidicheng); Du Fu lived there 2 or 3 years; a national heritage site since 2006.
